name: osv-scanner
args: bin=$(command -v osv-scanner || echo /osv-scanner); "$bin" scan source --recursive --format json --output "$1" "$2"; rc=$?; if [ $rc -eq 128 ]; then printf '{"results":[]}\n' > "$1"; exit 0; fi; [ $rc -le 1 ] || exit $rc

name: oxlint
args: mkdir -p /tmp/ox && npm install --prefix /tmp/ox --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --no-save {install} >&2 && cd "$2" && /tmp/ox/node_modules/.bin/oxlint --format json . > /tmp/ox/saida.txt; rc=$?; [ $rc -le 1 ] || exit $rc; node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const t=fs.readFileSync("/tmp/ox/saida.txt","utf8");const i=t.indexOf("{");if(i<0)process.exit(3);const j=JSON.parse(t.slice(i));if(!Array.isArray(j.diagnostics))process.exit(3);fs.writeFileSync(process.argv[1],JSON.stringify(j))' "$1" || exit 3
